scope: C7 modeled cache-entry loss and exact worker unregister in a fresh owned Chrome profile; ordinary keyboard-activated offline UI. No native eviction, real quota, physical device, first-pointer, human flight, process-restart or public deployment qualification. Empty stores are not nonempty content-preservation evidence. Data coverage is limited to the four existing FPV continuity databases and revealline.flight-profiles.v1. Gym records and other localStorage keys are not observed.

input.faults: Explicit CacheStorage.delete of one verified entry; exact ServiceWorkerRegistration.unregister
